newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Abu Dhabi says to set up diverse leasing firm.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi says to set up diverse leasing firm.

text.p: Oil-rich Abu Dhabi is setting up a leasing company that will offer contracts ranging from aircraft to medical equipment, its founders said on Monday.
The United Arab Emirates Offsets Group (UOG) and Abu Dhabi Investment Company (ADIC) are launching the company, they said in a statement.
The UOG and ADIC plan to launch the company through an initial public offering targeting UAE nationals by the last quarter of 1997 or first quarter of 1998, said the statement.
"Current plans show that the leasing company will grow rapidly to have assets under management in excess of $1 billion within a few years," it said.

"By the time the company is floated to the private sector, it is expected to have leases worth several hundred millions of dollars under management. Negotiations are underway with regional and international partners to partake in the project."
Officials close to the company told Reuters on Sunday the company has already secured deals worth $300 million, but did not elaborate.
